description: Defines the Addr class for managing cache record addresses in a disk cache system, including address encoding, file type handling, and related constants.

classes.name: disk_cache::Addr
classes.description: Represents a storage address for cache records, providing methods for address manipulation, validation, and file type determination.

methods.name: Addr()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing address value to zero.

methods.name: explicit Addr(CacheAddr address)
methods.description: Constructor initializing address with a given CacheAddr.

methods.name: Addr(FileType file_type, int max_blocks, int block_file, int index)
methods.description: Constructs an address based on file type, maximum blocks, block file, and index.

methods.name: value()
methods.description: Returns the current address value.

methods.name: set_value(CacheAddr address)
methods.description: Sets the address value.

methods.name: is_initialized()
methods.description: Checks if the address is initialized.

methods.name: is_separate_file()
methods.description: Determines if the address points to a separate file.

methods.name: is_block_file()
methods.description: Determines if the address points to a block file.

methods.name: file_type()
methods.description: Returns the file type of the address.

methods.name: FileNumber()
methods.description: Returns the file number associated with the address.

methods.name: start_block()
methods.description: Returns the start block index (implementation not shown).

methods.name: num_blocks()
methods.description: Returns the number of blocks (implementation not shown).

methods.name: SetFileNumber(int file_number)
methods.description: Sets the file number (implementation not shown).

methods.name: BlockSize()
methods.description: Returns the block size based on file type.

methods.name: operator==(Addr other)
methods.description: Equality comparison operator.

methods.name: operator!=(Addr other)
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator.

methods.name: BlockSizeForFileType(FileType file_type)
methods.description: Static method returning block size for a given file type.

methods.name: RequiredFileType(int size)
methods.description: Static method determining required file type based on size.

methods.name: RequiredBlocks(int size, FileType file_type)
methods.description: Static method calculating number of blocks needed for a size and file type.

methods.name: SanityCheck()
methods.description: Validates the address (implementation not shown).

methods.name: SanityCheckForEntry()
methods.description: Validates the address for an entry (implementation not shown).

methods.name: SanityCheckForRankings()
methods.description: Validates the address for rankings (implementation not shown).
